text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I can't believe I got hurt during training…
choice_data_list: We'll be more careful next time.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, don't worry! It only hurts a little! I'll be fit as a fiddle in no time!
choice_data_list: Overdoing it isn't going to help.
Overdoing it isn't going to help.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh… You're right. I should take it easy.
After I tend to her, we agree to take the rest of the day off, just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Maybe I was a little too eager to become the top Umamusume in all of Japan…
After I tend to her, we agree to take the rest of the day off, just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …I'm not going to be discouraged by something like this.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My mom always said that an injury is a child's badge of honor.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So I'm sure that this injury will become a badge that shows how hard I worked to become the best in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty, I'll focus on recovery so I can start training again!
After tending to Special Week's injury, I follow her wishes, and we continue our training.
